SELECT states.state_name, SUM(crop_production.production_quantity) AS total_production
FROM states
JOIN districts ON districts.state_id = states.state_id
JOIN crop_production ON crop_production.district_id = districts.district_id
JOIN crops ON crop_production.crop_id = crops.crop_id
WHERE crop_production.year = 2015 AND crops.crop_name = 'Wheat'
GROUP BY states.state_name
ORDER BY total_production DESC
LIMIT 5;
